name: Patterns of work
what: Repeated calls, repeated writes, the same content entering a model's context again, and the shape of agents' work show as lists ranked by what they cost in time, money and disk, not as graphs of agents. A map shows which paths every run touches and who is writing what now.

suggest.why: You asked for the record to be a ground for noticing and improving how agents work, and this is that place.
